summary: Docker Compose cho phép định nghĩa và chạy ứng dụng đa-container một cách dễ dàng sử dụng file cấu hình YAML, thay thế các lệnh docker phức tạp.
usecases: Orchestrate local development environments with multiple services (database, cache, web server).
Define reproducible CI/CD pipelines with dependent services.
Simplify testing of microservices with all dependencies up in one command.
ideas: Combine with Terraform for complete infrastructure as code management.
Create automated dev environments on cloud (AWS/EKS) from compose files.
Use for edge computing orchestration with lightweight containers.
